## Line breaks

## Images

Markdown image syntax:

![A square](./index.assets/square.svg)

A raw HTML `<img>` tag:

<img src="./index.assets/square.svg" alt="A square shown at 160px" width="160">

## Math

Inline math looks like $E = mc^2$.

Block math:

$$
a^2 + b^2 = c^2
$$
